# rmoff.net

> > Technical blog covering Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, stream processing, OBIEE (Oracle Business Intelligence), and data engineering topics with deep-dive tutorials and troubleshooting guides.

Written by Robin Moffatt, this site documents hands-on experience with streaming data platforms, particularly Apache Kafka and Confluent technologies, alongside extensive Oracle OBIEE content. The blog combines practical tutorials, performance monitoring techniques, and career reflections from a data engineering and DevRel perspective.

## Key Topics

- Apache Kafka
- Kafka Connect
- ksqlDB
- Stream Processing
- OBIEE (Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition)
- Single Message Transforms (SMT)
- JMX Monitoring
- Confluent Platform
- DuckDB
- REST API
- WebLogic Server
- Log4j Configuration
- Debezium
- Data Engineering
- DevRel

## Kafka Connect and Stream Processing

- [Kafka Connect - Deep Dive into Single Message Transforms](https://rmoff.net/2021/01/04/kafka-connect-deep-dive-into-single-message-transforms): Comprehensive video series on Kafka Connect SMT data transformations
- [Changing the Logging Level for Kafka Connect Dynamically](https://rmoff.net/2020/01/16/changing-the-logging-level-for-kafka-connect-dynamically): Dynamic log level changes in Kafka Connect using KIP-495 features
- [Kafka Connect Change Log Level and Write Log to File](https://rmoff.net/2019/01/29/kafka-connect-change-log-level-and-write-log-to-file): Configuring Kafka Connect log4j logging levels and file output
- [Primitive Keys in ksqlDB](https://rmoff.net/2020/02/07/primitive-keys-in-ksqldb): Handling primitive message keys in ksqlDB with Debezium connectors
- [Using httpie with the Kafka REST Proxy](https://rmoff.net/2019/03/08/using-httpie-with-the-kafka-rest-proxy): Tutorial on using httpie with Confluent Kafka REST Proxy API

## OBIEE Monitoring and Performance

- [OBIEE performance monitoring and alerting with jManage](https://rmoff.net/2009/07/29/obiee-performance-monitoring-and-alerting-with-jmanage): Guide to monitoring OBIEE performance using jManage and JMX MBeans
- [Collecting OBIEE systems management data with jmx](https://rmoff.net/2010/12/06/collecting-obiee-systems-management-data-with-jmx): Tutorial on collecting OBIEE metrics using JMX and MBeans
- [Visualising OBIEE DMS Metrics over the years](https://rmoff.net/2016/02/26/visualising-obiee-dms-metrics-over-the-years): Evolution of OBIEE DMS metrics visualization with Grafana and InfluxDB
- [Lifting the Lid on OBIEE 12c Web Services - Part 1](https://rmoff.net/2016/05/24/lifting-the-lid-on-obiee-12c-web-services-part-1): Exploring OBIEE 12c REST and SOAP web services architecture with sysdig

## OBIEE Configuration and Integration

- [Changing LDAP settings in an OBIEE RPD with UDML](https://rmoff.net/2011/02/23/changing-ldap-settings-in-an-obiee-rpd-with-udml): How-to guide for modifying LDAP configuration in OBIEE RPD using UDML
- [Connecting to OBIEE via JDBC - with jisql](https://rmoff.net/2016/03/28/connecting-to-obiee-via-jdbc-with-jisql): Tutorial on connecting to OBIEE using JDBC and jisql command-line client

## OBIEE Troubleshooting

- [OBIEE 12c hangs at startup - Starting AdminServer …](https://rmoff.net/2016/05/20/obiee-12c-hangs-at-startup-starting-adminserver-...): Resolving OBIEE 12c AdminServer startup hang with boot properties
- [oracle.bi.bar.exceptions.UnSupportedBarException: The Bar file provided as input is not supported in this BI Platfrom release.](https://rmoff.net/2016/05/19/oracle.bi.bar.exceptions.unsupportedbarexception-the-bar-file-provided-as-input-is-not-supported-in-this-bi-platfrom-release.): Fixing OBIEE 12c BAR file import errors with importServiceInstance
- [OBIEE Baseline Validation Tool - Parameter 'directory' is not a directory](https://rmoff.net/2016/05/18/obiee-baseline-validation-tool-parameter-directory-is-not-a-directory): Troubleshooting OBIEE Baseline Validation Tool directory error
